review_candidates.title: Cyber Security Analyst
review_candidates.description: Company Description Ethiopian Electric Power (EEP) is the national electric power generation and transmission company of Ethiopia, responsible for developing and operating major power plants and high-voltage networks. The organization plays a key role in supporting the country’s economic growth by expanding reliable and sustainable energy infrastructure. EEP manages a diverse portfolio of generation assets, including hydro, wind, and other renewable energy projects, and collaborates with domestic and international partners on strategic energy initiatives. Working at EEP offers professionals the opportunity to contribute to large-scale national projects, modernize critical infrastructure, and support the secure delivery of electricity to communities and businesses across Ethiopia. Role Description The Cyber Security Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, responsible for protecting EEP’s information systems, networks, and critical infrastructure from cyber threats. The analyst monitors security alerts and logs, investigates suspicious activities, and responds to incidents to minimize risk and impact. Day-to-day activities include conducting vulnerability assessments, supporting secure application and system configurations, and performing malware and threat analysis. The role also involves implementing and maintaining network and application security controls, preparing technical reports, and collaborating with IT and operations teams to enhance overall cybersecurity posture. The analyst assists in developing security policies, procedures, and awareness initiatives to ensure compliance with internal standards and applicable regulations. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Cybersecurity and Analytical Skills for monitoring threats, assessing risks, and supporting incident response. Candidates should possess Network Security skills to secure network devices, segments, and communication channels within operational and corporate environments. Candidates should possess Application Security skills to support secure software deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management. Candidates should possess Malware Analysis skills to identify, analyze, and help remediate malicious code and related security events. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., CEH, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent) are an advantage. Experience with security monitoring tools, SIEM platforms, firewalls, endpoint protection, and intrusion detection/prevention systems. Strong understanding of security frameworks and standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST) and familiarity with risk management and compliance practices. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, communicate clearly in written and verbal form, and maintain high ethical and confidentiality standards.

review_candidates.title: Engenheiro(a) de Governança Microsoft 365 / SharePoint Online
review_candidates.description: Responsabilidades e Atribuições Conduzir o discovery automatizado e o inventário completo do ambiente SharePoint Online: sites, permissões, compartilhamentos externos, usuários convidados e consumo de storage, incluindo o storage não aparente em versões, lixeira e Preservation Hold Library. Classificar os sites por tipo de uso, criticidade e risco, e aplicar o Modelo de Maturidade Microsoft 365 com evidência rastreável para cada nota. Elaborar o business case de storage e emitir as decisões arquiteturais formais (ADR - Architecture Decision Record) de arquivamento e de backup, validadas por prova de conceito. Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e de negócio com as áreas do cliente e apresentar o diagnóstico ao comitê executivo. Redigir a Política de Governança, a Matriz RACI (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) e o padrão de nomenclatura e taxonomia de sites. Configurar o provisionamento padronizado, as políticas de criação de sites e os limites de storage no SharePoint Admin Center. Implantar as soluções de arquivamento e de backup, com processo de reativação e teste de restauração documentados. Remediar exposições por compartilhamento anônimo e externo, e implantar revisão periódica de acesso de usuários convidados. Conduzir os testes integrados e o ciclo de UAT (User Acceptance Test, teste de aceitação do usuário) com os usuários-chave do cliente. Executar o go-live e a transferência de conhecimento para o time de sustentação do cliente. Atuar como referência técnica sênior do projeto: orientar, revisar e validar o trabalho dos demais profissionais da equipe, incluindo perfis menos experientes, e reportar-se ao gerente de projeto na cadência semanal. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência comprovada em administração de Microsoft SharePoint Online em ambiente corporativo de grande porte, acima de 5.000 sites. Experiência prática, não apenas conhecimento teórico ou de laboratório. PnP PowerShell (Patterns and Practices) e SharePoint Online Management Shell em nível avançado, com desenvolvimento de scripts próprios para inventário, configuração e remediação em escala. Microsoft Graph API (Application Programming Interface) com autenticação app-only por certificado, incluindo tratamento de throttling (HTTP 429 e Retry-After), paginação e requisições em lote. Microsoft Entra ID: App Registration, permissões de aplicação, consentimento de administrador, grupos do Microsoft 365 e gestão de convidados B2B (Business to Business). Microsoft Purview: rótulos de sensibilidade, DLP (Data Loss Prevention, prevenção contra perda de dados), políticas e rótulos de retenção. Estratégias de storage e ciclo de vida no Microsoft 365, incluindo Microsoft 365 Archive, políticas de site inativo e gestão de cota de tenant. Governança de Microsoft Teams e de Grupos do Microsoft 365, incluindo políticas de nomenclatura e de expiração. Redação de política, processo e documentação técnica em português, com qualidade para leitura por público executivo. Idiomas Inglês: Intermediário Espanhol: Não possui Informações Adicionais: Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto, horário comercial, 40 horas semanais.

Assess emerging AI technologies, platforms, and architectural patterns, providing leadership on technology selection and adoption. Develop and execute AI transformation roadmaps that establish enterprise AI foundations and long-term scalability. Design and operationalize end-to-end AI platforms supporting model development, deployment, monitoring, governance, and lifecycle management. Lead the integration of AI/ML technologies across data platforms, model ecosystems, MLOps, cloud infrastructure, security, and governance frameworks. Architect and build custom AI platform components to address complex business and technical requirements. Optimize compute infrastructure, model-serving environments, and distributed AI workloads for scalability, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Establish enterprise AI operational standards, including observability, monitoring, performance management, and platform resilience. Implement Responsible AI, security, privacy, risk management, and compliance controls across AI solutions and platforms. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define AI governance models, architecture standards, and best practices. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architecture, engineering, and data teams throughout AI initiatives. Strong experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud and their AI/ML services. Expertise in MLOps, AI platform engineering, model deployment, monitoring, and operationalization. Experience implementing AI security, governance, compliance, and Responsible AI frameworks. Strong architecture leadership experience with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and technology strategy. Preferred Qualifications Experience establishing Enterprise AI Foundations, AI Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI Transformation programs. Knowledge of vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and advanced AI architecture patterns. Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, distributed computing, and high-performance AI infrastructure. Expertise in AI observability, model performance optimization, platform reliability, and cost management. Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills. Relevant certifications in Cloud Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Enterprise Architecture are preferred.
